correctness.rationale: For positive shift weights (j+1)^(-beta), a generalized Aluthge transform averages log weights between j and j+1, so n iterates at common t_n equal expectation of log(j+1+Bin(n,t_n)). For m_n=n t_n approaching finite lambda, binomial-to-Poisson convergence and uniform integrability plus summable majorant (j+1)^(-beta*r) for beta*r>1 prove Schatten r convergence. For m_n→infinity, concentration at m and a Chernoff lower-tail bound give locally uniform scaled weights and summable tail domination; a Riemann-sum proof yields Schatten mass m^(1-beta*r)/(beta*r−1). The Frullani representation yields a positive Levy jump kernel alpha(1−u)^j/[−log(1−u)] du and hence strictly completely monotone trace F_r(lambda). Poisson independent increments give the nonlinear positive-weight semigroup. Independent numerical binomial/Poisson first-weight convergence was reproduced for n=200, mean=2, j=0,1,5,20. Finite calculations were supplementary.
